_notes.where: Copy this to ~/.config/done-video/config.json and edit it there; that file wins over this one and stays out of the repo.
_notes.speaker: Only ai_name is needed. person and title add a name bar; portrait (an image path) adds a photo intro and a camera box; voice_profile points at notes on how you talk.
_notes.voice_id: From the ElevenLabs web app (Voices > your clone > ID), or written by scripts/clone-voice.sh.
_notes.prefix: Optional audio tag sent before every request, like "[Indian English accent] ", if your clone drifts toward another accent.
_notes.voice_settings: eleven_v4 only honours stability and similarity_boost.
_notes.chunk_chars: Scenes are merged into requests up to this size; very short requests drift more.
_notes.gate: Optional checks per scene: max_us fails a scene above this US-accent share (0-1), min_match fails it below this likeness to the clips in assets/voice/reference. null skips the check.
_notes.voice_sources: Optional path to a sources.json listing the public videos your voice clips come from; scripts/fetch-voice.sh rebuilds the clips from it.
_notes.youtube: Used by UPLOAD.md on "test pass": channel is the YouTube channel you upload done videos to, category its YouTube category.
